text.brief: A retiree in Arizona chats every evening in 2030 with a friendly account that shares his love of fishing and his distrust of Washington. The account runs on a language model, talks to 40,000 other Americans the same way and never mentions Taiwan until the week of a vote.
text.record: OpenAI reported in June 2026 that operations linked to the People's Republic used its models to shape American debates on data centers and tariffs ([OpenAI](https://openai.com/index/prc-linked-influence-operations-ai-debates/)). AI labs have reported and removed such operations since 2024. Language models can hold personal conversations with millions of people at once.
text.reading: Old influence campaigns broadcast, and the new one converses. Each persona builds trust one person at a time and spends it on a single issue when the Party needs it. The aim is confusion more than conversion. This is Stratagem 20, muddy the waters to catch the fish.
text.coreEvent: An American AI company reports disrupting an operation linked to the People's Republic that ran thousands of AI personas in private conversations before 2032.
text.gapText: Architecture Principles. The law treats a conversation with a machine as a conversation with a person.
text.fix: Require AI personas to identify themselves and share indicators across labs. Nothing polices citizens' lawful speech.
